citations.claim: Policy AUT-4471 has endorsement PP 03 24 06 24 attached.
citations.detail:
## Endorsements Attached

- PP 03 24 06 24

citations.source: policy:PP 03 24 06 24#Extended Transportation Expenses > Transportation Expenses > Daily Amount and Maximum
citations.claim: The endorsement sets the per-day amount and maximum days.
citations.detail:
We will pay **$50 per day, for a maximum of 21 days** per occurrence, for
reasonable expenses you incur for a rental vehicle while your covered auto is
withdrawn from use because of a loss covered under Part IV.

citations.source: policy:PP 03 24 06 24#Extended Transportation Expenses > Transportation Expenses > What This Replaces
citations.claim: The endorsement replaces the daily amount and maximum number of days in the base form where attached.
citations.detail:
The daily amount and the maximum number of days stated in the Schedule of Limits
and Deductibles of the form this endorsement amends do not apply where this
endorsement is attached.

citations.source: policy:PP 00 01 06 24#Part IV — Physical Damage Coverage > 4.4 Rental Reimbursement
citations.claim: The base form's rental reimbursement amount and maximum (superseded by the attached endorsement).
citations.detail:
Under form PP 00 01 06 24 we will pay **$40 per day, for a maximum of
30 days** per occurrence.

Coverage begins 24 hours after the loss is reported to us and ends on the
earliest of the day your covered auto is returned to use, the day we pay the
actual cash value for a total loss, or the day the 30-day maximum
is reached.
